children: Lexeo Therapeutics entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire Mantle Therapeutics, adding Mantle as a wholly owned subsidiary. The deal provides $5.3 million in cash and $3.0 million in Lexeo common stock at closing, with potential contingent consideration of up to $13 million, including a $1 million additional cash payment and up to $12 million tied to development and regulatory milestones over 12 years. Shares issued at closing will be unregistered under Section 4(a)(2) and/or Regulation D. Key Mantle stockholders holding a majority have agreed to support the transaction, which is subject to customary closing conditions.
